---
title: "Metric cards"
toc: true
toc-location: left
---

Every metric in beam's registry is described by a metric card: a small YAML file
that declares what the metric measures, its measurement scale, its polarity, its
declared range, how to normalize it, and how to pool it across datasets. The
pipeline reads these fields so that ranking decisions follow from the metric
definition rather than from a hidden default. The cards below are generated from
the registry, so this page always matches the shipped cards.

For how the pipeline consumes these fields, see [Cards and pipeline](explanations/cards-and-pipeline.qmd).

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| warning: false
import html

from beam.cards import Registry

reg = Registry()

groups = [
    ("Clustering", ["ari", "nmi", "silhouette", "shannon_entropy_diff", "nclust_deviation"]),
    ("Classification", ["accuracy", "f1_score", "calibration_slope"]),
    ("Forecasting", ["smape", "mase"]),
    ("Efficiency", ["runtime", "peak_memory"]),
    ("Single-cell integration", [
        "asw_batch", "asw_label", "isolated_label_asw", "isolated_label_f1",
        "kbet", "ilisi", "clisi", "graph_connectivity", "hvg_overlap",
        "cell_cycle_conservation", "pcr",
    ]),
    ("Spatial", ["correlation"]),
    ("Transportation (toy set)", ["speed", "cost", "co2"]),
]

assigned = {mid for _, ids in groups for mid in ids}
leftover = [mid for mid in reg.list_ids() if mid not in assigned]
if leftover:
    groups.append(("Other", leftover))


def fmt_num(x):
    if isinstance(x, bool):
        return str(x)
    try:
        f = float(x)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return str(x)
    return str(int(f)) if f.is_integer() else str(x)


def fmt_range(card):
    rng = card.semantics.get("range")
    if not rng or (rng.get("lower") is None and rng.get("upper") is None):
        return "unbounded"
    lo = rng.get("lower")
    hi = rng.get("upper")
    left = "[" if rng.get("lower_inclusive", True) else "("
    right = "]" if rng.get("upper_inclusive", True) else ")"
    lo_s = "-inf" if lo is None else fmt_num(lo)
    hi_s = "inf" if hi is None else fmt_num(hi)
    return f"{left}{lo_s}, {hi_s}{right}"


def polarity_pill(card):
    p = card.polarity
    if p == "higher_is_better":
        return "mc-higher", "higher is better"
    if p == "lower_is_better":
        return "mc-lower", "lower is better"
    return "mc-neutral", p.replace("_", " ")


def reference_html(card):
    if not card.citations:
        return None
    c = card.citations[0]
    text = html.escape(c.get("text", "").strip())
    doi = c.get("doi")
    if doi:
        url = f"https://doi.org/{html.escape(doi)}"
        text += f' <a href="{url}">{html.escape(doi)}</a>'
    return text


def ontology_html(card):
    parts = []
    for key, iri in card.mappings.items():
        label = iri.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]
        parts.append(f'{html.escape(key.upper())}: <a href="{html.escape(iri)}">{html.escape(label)}</a>')
    return " &middot; ".join(parts) if parts else None


def card_html(card):
    cls, label = polarity_pill(card)
    desc = " ".join(card.description.split())
    facts = [
        ("Task", ", ".join(card.task) if card.task else "general"),
        ("Scale", card.scale_type),
        ("Range", fmt_range(card)),
        ("Normalization", card.recommended_normalization or "min_max (default)"),
        ("Across datasets", card.recommended_aggregation_across_datasets or "not set"),
        ("Ground truth", "required" if card.requires_ground_truth else "not required"),
    ]
    dl = '<dl class="mc-facts">' + "".join(
        f"<dt>{html.escape(k)}</dt><dd>{html.escape(str(v))}</dd>" for k, v in facts
    ) + "</dl>"
    out = [
        '<div class="metric-card">',
        f'<div class="mc-head"><span class="mc-id">{html.escape(card.id)}</span>'
        f'<span class="mc-polarity {cls}">{html.escape(label)}</span></div>',
        f'<div class="mc-name">{html.escape(card.name)}</div>',
        f'<p class="mc-desc">{html.escape(desc)}</p>',
        dl,
    ]
    ref = reference_html(card)
    if ref:
        out.append(f'<p class="mc-ref">{ref}</p>')
    onto = ontology_html(card)
    if onto:
        out.append(f'<p class="mc-onto">{onto}</p>')
    out.append("</div>")
    return "".join(out)


for title, ids in groups:
    cards = [reg.get(mid) for mid in ids]
    if not cards:
        continue
    print(f"## {title}\n")
    print('<div class="metric-card-grid">' + "".join(card_html(c) for c in cards) + "</div>")
    print()
```
